item.title: AI Techniques for Performance, Reliability, and Sustainability of Modern Software Systems
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research on the application of artificial intelligence methods to improve key aspects of modern software systems. The focus encompasses using AI to enhance system performance, increase reliability, and promote sustainability in software engineering and operations.

item.title: Bridging AI, Automation, and Sustainability in Software Testing
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in the Journal of Systems and Software focuses on the intersection of artificial intelligence, automation, and sustainability within software testing. The call seeks research that explores how AI and automated approaches can be leveraged to improve testing efficiency while addressing environmental and sustainability concerns in the software development lifecycle.

Appel publié par Journal of Systems and Software. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • AI in software testing
  • Automation in software testing
  • Sustainability in software testing
  • Integration of AI and automation for testing purposes
  • Environmental impact of software testing practices

Timeline

  • October 15, 2026: Submission deadline

item.title: Software Quality Assurance for Artificial Intelligence
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on quality assurance challenges and solutions specific to artificial intelligence systems. As AI becomes increasingly integrated into critical applications, ensuring software quality through rigorous testing, validation, and assurance practices is essential for building reliable and trustworthy AI systems.

Appel publié par Journal of Systems and Software. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Quality assurance methodologies for AI systems
  • Testing and validation of machine learning models
  • AI system reliability and robustness
  • Software engineering practices for AI development
  • AI safety and security testing
  • Performance evaluation of AI systems
  • Continuous integration and deployment for AI
  • Regulatory compliance and standards for AI software

item.title: Consistency Management in Software-Intensive Systems
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on the challenges of managing consistency across diverse artifacts and components in software-intensive systems. As modern software systems become increasingly complex and distributed, maintaining consistency among heterogeneous models, code, documentation, and configurations becomes a critical concern for practitioners and researchers alike.

Appel publié par Journal of Systems and Software. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Consistency management approaches and techniques for handling heterogeneous artifacts
  • Version control and traceability in large-scale systems
  • Conflict detection and resolution strategies
  • Consistency checking and validation methods
  • Multi-model consistency approaches
  • Change propagation and impact analysis
  • Tool support and automation for consistency management
  • Application of consistency management in different software development paradigms
